title: Want to See the Northern Lights, Enjoy Hot Springs or Travel Around the World? ITF Fair Offers Diverse Travel Options
site_name: Taiwan Immigrants' Global News Network-Want to See the Northern Lights, Enjoy Hot Springs or Travel Around the World? ITF Fair Offers Diverse Travel Options
excerpt: Want to See the Northern Lights, Enjoy Hot Springs or Travel Around the World? ITF Fair Offers Diverse Travel Options
content:
The 2026 ITF Taipei International Travel Fair will take place from November 6 to 9 at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, Hall 1. Visitors can explore a wide range of travel options, including world voyages, polar expeditions, scenic train journeys, winter illuminations, skiing, New Year celebrations and Lunar New Year tours.

For travelers seeking long-haul adventures, Southeast Travel offers Peace Boat world cruises lasting 104 days from Keelung in 2027, starting at NT$490,000, and 106 days from Kaohsiung in 2028, starting at NT$525,000. Lion Travel features a 20-day Antarctic Peninsula expedition starting at NT$1 million, along with Alpine scenic train journeys. Other options include Northern Lights tours in Finland and Canada, Mediterranean cruises and wildlife migration experiences in East Africa.

Seasonal highlights include the winter illuminations in Shirakawa-go, stays at Ginzan Onsen, skiing in Japan and South Korea, and New Year fireworks. Sports and outdoor enthusiasts can consider the Okinawa Marathon, Seoul International Marathon and Kumano Kodo hiking routes.

Travelers who prefer to stay in Taiwan can explore Alishan, the Tefuye Trail and Danayigu through itineraries featuring forest ecology, rail travel, local culture and sustainable tourism.

Advance tickets are available until November 5 for NT$180 each through Klook, KKday, ibon, FamiTicket, udn Ticketing and TaiTIX. The fair opens from noon to 6 p.m. on November 6 and from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on November 7–9 at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, Hall 1, Levels 1 and 4.
